name: Heavy Duty Jute Gunny Sacks – 90–100 kg
shortDesc: Robust 100% natural jute sacks engineered for maximum load bearing, ideal for agriculture, construction and industrial bulk storage.
longDesc:
Our Heavy Duty Jute Gunny Sacks are purpose-engineered for the most demanding bulk storage and transportation applications. Woven from premium-grade raw jute fibres sourced directly from certified farms in West Bengal and Bangladesh, each sack undergoes rigorous tensile-strength testing to guarantee it holds its rated load under real-world export and logistics conditions.

The HKL-sewn hem provides a double-lock stitch at every seam, virtually eliminating seam failure during mechanical handling and stacking. The distinctive green centre stripe is not merely cosmetic — it serves as a quick visual identifier during warehouse sorting, reducing handling errors and mix-ups in busy logistics environments.

Every bale is packed to export-standard dimensions and iron-bound for container stuffing efficiency. With an industry-leading bale density of 400 bags per bale, our heavy-duty sacks cut your per-unit freight cost while maintaining the structural integrity demanded by port handling equipment and long ocean transits.
customization: Custom printed logo or brand name
Inner liner options (HDPE or kraft paper)
Phytosanitary and fumigation treatment on request

name: Jute Gunny Bag for Coffee & Cocoa Beans
shortDesc: Food-grade breathable jute bags purpose-built for specialty coffee and cocoa storage, maintaining bean quality through natural moisture management.
longDesc:
Coffee and cocoa beans are hygroscopic commodities — they absorb and release moisture continuously after harvest, and the packaging they travel in directly determines whether they arrive at destination as a premium crop or a compromised one. Our jute gunny bags for coffee and cocoa are woven to a tighter specification that balances two competing needs: sufficient breathability to allow off-gassing and prevent condensation build-up, and enough structural integrity to survive the multi-modal supply chains that connect tropical origin countries with roasters in Europe, North America and East Asia.

The food-grade natural jute fibre we use for these bags is free of synthetic coatings, bleaching agents and chemical preservatives, making them fully compliant with food-contact material regulations across major importing markets including the EU, UK, USA and Japan. The blue centre stripe is widely recognised in the commodity trade as the standard identifier for coffee-grade jute sacks, ensuring your shipment is handled according to food-commodity protocols at every port stop.

We supply these bags to exporters across Karnataka, Kerala, Tamil Nadu and the North-East, as well as to trading houses exporting Ethiopian, Ugandan and Vietnamese origin beans transshipped through Indian ports. Phytosanitary treatment and fumigation certificates can be arranged prior to container loading on request.
customization: Custom logo printing or brand stencilling
GrainPro or liner bag compatibility modifications
Weight options from 60 kg to 70 kg capacity

name: Jute Gunny Sacks 50–60 kg
shortDesc: Versatile mid-weight jute sacks for grain, fertilizer, produce and construction materials — the workhorse of agricultural supply chains.
longDesc:
The 50–60 kg jute gunny sack is the most widely deployed packaging format in Indian and global agricultural trade, and for good reason: its combination of manageable size, robust construction and low unit cost makes it the natural choice for a vast range of commodities from paddy and wheat to onions, potatoes and fertilizer granules. Our JSB-0003 is built to this proven specification with the material integrity and stitch quality that buyers in both domestic FCI-approved procurement and international export markets have come to expect from a serious manufacturer.

The plain-sewn construction on this model is entirely appropriate for the load range: for 50–60 kg applications the stitch strength is more than adequate, and the simpler construction allows us to deliver at extremely competitive unit pricing without compromising on jute quality or weave density. The optional blue stripe variant is available for buyers whose customers use stripe colour to differentiate commodity types at warehouse intake.

This size range is also the most popular choice for buyers who want to combine multiple commodity uses from a single SKU — the same bag that stores wheat in a Punjab warehouse ships potatoes out of Agra and handles cement in a construction supply chain. If your operation spans multiple commodities, the JSB-0003 is the economical way to standardise your packaging inventory.

HDPE inner liner for moisture-sensitive commodities

name: Jute Gunny Sacks for Nuts & Cashew
shortDesc: Premium jute sacks optimised for cashew and tree-nut export, combining food-safe natural fibre with the breathability critical for nut quality preservation.
longDesc:
India is the world's largest processor and exporter of cashew nuts, and the packaging used for export plays a direct role in the premium the commodity commands at destination. Our JSB-0004 jute gunny sacks for cashew and tree nuts are manufactured to the exacting standards of Cashew Export Promotion Council of India (CEPC) recommendations and international food-import compliance requirements in the EU, USA and Gulf markets.

The breathable open-weave construction of natural jute is ideally suited to cashew storage because it allows the slow equilibration of moisture content that keeps kernels crisp without promoting the humidity spikes that cause mould or aflatoxin contamination. Unlike synthetic woven polypropylene alternatives, our jute sacks do not generate static charge, do not leach plasticisers into the food product, and are fully biodegradable at end of life — a growing requirement in EU and UK import documentation.

We supply these bags to processors and exporters in Kollam, Mangalore, Goa, Daman and Mumbai — India's primary cashew processing corridor — and have established supply relationships with nut exporters sourcing product from West Africa, Vietnam and Brazil for repackaging and re-export through Indian ports. Our quality control team samples every production batch against a standard reference sack maintained in our testing laboratory to ensure dimensional consistency and stitch count compliance.
customization: Custom capacity from 40 kg to 80 kg
